header: THE SERVER'S HALF OF THE ERROR LOG (22 Nov 2026), started by src/instrumentation.ts:
* onRequestError of Next: every error a route, a page or a server action THROWS reaches reportServerRequestError;

* console.error: the routes of this application catch most failures, log them with console.error and answer with a message, so I wrap console.error in installServerErrorLog and those are recorded too (the original console.error still runs first, the terminal and the host's logs are unchanged).

ONLY IN PRODUCTION (and not when ERROR_LOG=off): a development run shares the database with production and has its own files (.dev-server.log, .browser-console.log). Limits: 30 records a minute from this server copy, whatever happens (an outage cannot flood the table), the model asked at most 20 times an hour (report.ts). On Vercel I hand the write to the platform's waitUntil when it is there, so the function is not frozen before the record is saved.

doc: Greater than 0 while this file is recording an error (connecting to the database included): errors raised meanwhile are the recording's own, so I do not record them again.
